text:
Maya Patel: Quick audit FYI — ran the onboarding cohort query and ~23% of accounts marked `onboarding` have had 0 CS touches in the last 30 days. Likely a CRM status/last_activity mismatch.
Aj Chen: Ugh, that aligns with what I saw in the renewal queue — some accounts show active onboarding but no tasks. Do you have the query?
Maya Patel: Pasting the SQL I used to surface them — it's conservative but clear: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, status, last_activity_at, owner
FROM accounts
WHERE status = 'onboarding'
  AND (last_activity_at IS NULL OR last_activity_at < now() - interval '30 days')
  AND churn_risk IS DISTINCT FROM 'high' -- exclude obvious churn
ORDER BY last_activity_at NULLS FIRST;
```
Maya Patel: My proposal: add a small automation that syncs `last_activity_at` -> triggers a playbook if null/old, and creates an owner task. Low-risk toggle in the playbook engine.
Leo García: 👍 Can we scope this to only accounts with ARR > 5k for first rollout? Want to avoid noise for tiny customers.
Maya Patel: Yes — good call. I'll add an ARR filter.
Samir Khan: Who needs to sign off on the automation? Also what about edge cases where activity happened but wasn't logged in CRM?
Aj Chen: For sign-off: CS Ops and Data Infra. Edge cases — we should add an audit log and a rollback flag for 24 hrs plus a dry-run mode for the first week.
Maya Patel: Draft rollout plan: 1) dry-run job to slack-report matches (48h), 2) opt-in toggle for ARR>5k orgs (1 week), 3) enable owner task creation with 24h rollback window, 4) review impact & then full rollout.
Samir Khan: Can you add a column in the slack-report with sample contact and last_event_source so we can triage false-negatives?
Maya Patel: Yep. I'll include contact_email, last_event_source, and sample event id.
Aj Chen: Assigning owners: Maya will implement query and slack-report, Leo will set ARR gating, Samir + CS Ops will validate playbook actions, I'll coordinate infra side for the job.
Maya Patel: I'll spin up the dry-run this afternoon and post results here.
Playbook Bot: scheduled dry_run_crm_sync job created by Maya Patel — next run in 2h :gear:
Leo García: Thanks — if the dry-run looks good let's aim for opt-in toggle deployment next Tue during low traffic window.
Samir Khan: Ping me once results posted, I'll pull a quick sample and do manual contact checks.
Maya Patel: Will do. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
